notes.title: Small Changes and Fixes
notes.notes:
+ Added an aiming line that shows when aim is blocked (Can be disabled)
* Prevent firing when turret is not aligned with crosshair (Can be disabled)
* Fix various gamemode issues when players fall into a pit

notes.title: Conquest Nukes and Battle Changes
notes.notes:
+ Conquest: Matches now end with a nuclear bomb after a team holds all points for 35 seconds
+ Battle: After 2 minutes a shrinking ring will activate that kills players outside of it
+ Boosts can now be activated while playing a game
* Changed how often Conquest scores tick up
* Fixed local replays not always saving
* Improved performance a bit

notes.title: Bug fixes and improvements
notes.notes:
+ Conquest maps are now in rotation for Battle
* Wins/Losses/Draws now only get recorded if you have played for at least half of the match
* Win XP is now based on how long you were in the match
* Reduced lobby wait time to 15 seconds
* Game list page is now limited to current selected region
* Improved lag compensation
* Fixed smaller screens having farther vision in some cases
* Fixed Icebreaker replays not loading properly
* Removed rear shots in Battle from daily challenges
* Improved map loading to hopefully fix visual "grey box" glitches
* Bans/mutes can now have expiration times

notes.title: New Map, Holiday Bundle, and Balance Changes
notes.notes:
+ New Map: Icebreaker (Conquest)
+ New Bundle: Holiday Bundle
* P-70 Serf: Updated side armor
* CY-76 Longbow: Updated side armor
* M4 Jumbo: Turn Force 62N⋅m -> 56N⋅m, Turret Speed 37°/s -> 26°/s
* SI-2 Tsar: Turn Force 68N⋅m -> 59N⋅m, Turret Speed 34°/s -> 24°/s
* Panthera: Turn Force 68N⋅m -> 60N⋅m, Turret Speed 47°/s -> 41°/s
* Tigress I: Turn Force 56N⋅m -> 51N⋅m, Turret Speed 34°/s -> 32°/s
* Queen Tigress: Turn Force 62N⋅m -> 53N⋅m
* Hefty Mk. 1: Turn Force 74N⋅m -> 68N⋅m, Turret Speed 36°/s -> 34°/s
* C3 Half-Track: Reload 3.5s -> 3.9s, Engine Reverse 120hp -> 108hp
* Increased XP for winning a game to 2500
* Increased XP for a point being captured to 400
* Landmines now despawn after 2 minutes
* Increased bot amount in Conquest
* Changed bot behavior in Conquest
* Increased guest game XP cutoff to rank 25

notes.title: Balance update
notes.notes:
+ Added progress indicator for when you are repairing
+ Added game merging on round end if player count is low
* Repair time is now based on armor thickness (Min 8 sec, Max 12 sec)
* Lower caliber shells now have more penetration
* Higher caliber shells now have less penetration
* Penetration now decreases with shell travel distance
* Wall ricochet angle now increases with each ricochet
* Capture the Flag: Flags are now captured by taking them into a friendly capture zone
* Hamonag AT: Updated front armor hitbox
* Cheetah: Updated front armor hitbox
* Pummeler II: Updated front armor hitbox
* LT Mk. VI: Armament 53mm -> 47mm
* E1 Starhund: Decreased armor hardness, decreased shell penetration power
* Fixed map editor not starting play without a map name
* Fixed players sometimes appearing under objects on round end
* Fixed round end rank percentage rounding error

notes.title: Bug fixes and improvements
notes.notes:
+ Added lag compensation setting
* Improved map loading on slower connections
* Changed Free for All XP rate to 0.85
* Fixed Tiger Hunt capture ring sometimes not working properly
* Fixed gold claim issue
* Fixed daily rewards issue
* Fixed players sometimes being able to glitch out of the map on Jungle map
* Server optimizations

notes.title: Tank Game Update
notes.notes:
* Changed Gamemode: Tank Game
* Tank Game: Changed vehicle lineup
* Removed and updated some challenges
* Challenges no longer show in private games
* Updated shop tab art
